Filed by the director seat, summon #25 (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`), as the successor of objectui#9695 under ruling batch #146 item 5 letter A (maintainer 「146 同意」, objectstack#18012). ⛔ Filed bare: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are triage's production. Landing: `packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx` (the builder renders there, ⛔ not in `packages/app-shell` — the fence objectui#9695's dispatch got wrong).

## What the ruling asked, and what is already true

Ruling A: while one bound of a `between` pair is blank the condition is **incomplete — not emitted, and shown as incomplete in the UI**. Measured on objectui#9695 (dev report 5732116876, seat-verified 5732154132): the 「not emitted」 half is already implemented — `isFilterValueComplete` (`filter-builder.tsx`, arity-aware) gates every write/read path (`viewFilterFold.ts`, `ObjectView.tsx` `sanitizeViewOverride`, `plugin-list/ListView.tsx`) since objectui#5025; the render-side padding in `toPairBounds` is inert draft state and must stay (un-padding yields a one-element array `ViewFilterRuleSchema` refuses). The 「shown as incomplete」 half is **entirely unbuilt**: `filter-builder.tsx` carries zero `aria-invalid` affordance (control: `aria-label` fires 4 in the same file), so a half-filled range is silently dropped by every path with no signal to the author.

## Deliverable

- The empty bound of a half-filled pair carries `aria-invalid` (the tree's established idiom, pinned structurally in `CelPredicateField`, `ConditionWidget`, `ConditionalFormattingEditor`, `ConditionBuilder`) and an accessible description naming the missing bound; the completeness rule itself is ⛔ not changed.
- Pin: a pair with one blank bound renders the marker and is not emitted; a complete pair renders no marker and is emitted; a non-pair operator never renders it.
- ⛔ `reshapeFilterValue` / `toPairBounds` untouched (measured: nothing there needs to change).
- `Clause-②` declared from the diff (an accessibility attribute on a published component ⇒ the claiming seat decides; expected `no`).

## Not this card

The second live producer of a half-filled range (`packages/fields` `FilterConditionField`, `{ $gte, $lte: '' }`) is objectui#9914 — landed. The dataset-filter bridge's `between` arm is its own card, filed beside this one.
